entities.name: Bosco
entities.description: A young unguilded man who joins the Orzhov as a janitor, takes on five centuries of debt, and betrays his friend Drovo for the high prelate.

entities.name: Drovo
entities.description: Bosco's friend, lured into an Orzhov crypt and trapped with a crypt ghast.

entities.name: Jozica
entities.description: The Orzhov enforcer employed by the estate's owner, whom Bosco fears.

entities.name: high prelate
entities.description: An aged, sharp-minded Orzhov leader who contracts Bosco to deliver Drovo as a sacrifice.

entities.name: Jozica's thrull
entities.description: Jozica's personal thrull, which collects a mopper tax and whom Bosco hates.

entities.name: crypt ghast
entities.description: A masked, smoke-formed undead that emerges from a sarcophagus and attacks Drovo.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of debt, wealth and the dead.

entities.name: Gateless
entities.description: A group Drovo thought Bosco might join.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane the Orzhov claim to own.

entities.name: Sixth District
entities.description: A district of Ravnica with dank bogs.

entities.name: Orzhov mansion
entities.description: The Orzhov estate where Bosco works, with a hidden mausoleum below.

events.summary: Bosco, an Orzhov mopper, endures the mopper tax from Jozica's thrull while planning to rise.
Bosco tells Drovo he has taken on five centuries of debt to join the Orzhov.
events.quote: "That's how much debt I owe to the guild. Five centuries all told."

events.summary: Bosco meets Jozica and the high prelate and signs a magically binding contract to reduce his debt.
Bosco leads Drovo through a hidden passage to an Orzhov mausoleum.
events.quote: Drovo pulled open the oaken panel to reveal a small, stone staircase

events.summary: Bosco locks Drovo in the tomb, saying five centuries is too long.
events.quote: "Sorry Drovo. You were right, five centuries is too long."

events.summary: A crypt ghast forms from smoke and attacks the trapped Drovo.
events.quote: The apparition gasped with palpable pleasure

events.summary: The high prelate pays Bosco, promising more work, and Bosco no longer feels afraid.
events.quote: "You've proven yourself quite useful. There will be more work for you in the future."

relations.note: joinant who owes five centuries of debt
relations.quote: I was new to the Orzhov—a joinant.
You sign this, carry out your task, and your debt will be substantially reduced
Jozica, who stood impassively at the high prelate's side
